name: Viseu
mandate: PrompTugal.news Viseu: AI and technology in Viseu, a district capital of the Beira interior whose centre of gravity is its polytechnic university, the council's public-sector AI work and a regional industry that is just starting to talk about AI, and what reaches Viseu from Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Viseu's AI activity runs through public and academic bodies more than through startups. The Politécnico de Viseu, which became the Universidade Politécnica de Viseu on 1 August 2026, leads RiskMap, a 244,944 euro project to map building degradation with AI, and has published rules for AI use. On its campus the STAR Institute, a technology centre opened on 22 May 2026, lists AI first among its digitalisation areas and houses two startups. The municipality is a member of the AI4PA hub for public administration, and the intermunicipal body CIM Viseu Dão Lafões presented a data platform with AI tools for mayors on 29 October 2026.

look.landmark: The Sé Catedral and the granite old town on the hill, home of the Grão Vasco museum
look.motif: Dão wine country, grey granite, the Feira de São Mateus and the cold, green Beira interior

ai_news.title: Viseu Dão Lafões holds its first Smart Region Summit and shows a data and AI platform for mayors
ai_news.summary: On 29 October 2026 the intermunicipal body CIM Viseu Dão Lafões presented SMART REGION, two platforms (a regional knowledge one and an urban management one) that cross scattered data such as visitor flows, mobility and waste to help councils understand local needs. A second report, from Mais Aguiar da Beira on 31 October, says the Urban Management Platform offers AI tools for analysis and decision support and that CIM and MOBI.E signed a protocol on smart ticketing. Neither report names the models used.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional public body uses AI to turn data into decisions for the councils of Viseu and its neighbours: directly about AI, with the region's public sector as the user.

ai_news.title: IndustriaTech+AI 2026 puts AI on the factory-floor agenda in Viseu
ai_news.summary: An industrial and technology conference at the Montebelo Viseu Congress Hotel from 29 September to 1 October 2026, organised by the polytechnic's mechanical engineering and industrial management department with the council, the business association AIRV and Viseu Marca. AI is a central theme, including maintenance and AI.
ai_news.ai_path: An industry conference held in Viseu with AI as a stated central theme: directly about AI. The date is the event start because the page shows no publication date.

ai_news.title: Viseu hospital group buys PRR-funded scanners that include AI where applicable
ai_news.summary: The ULS Viseu Dão-Lafões got 5.8 million euros of recovery plan money for an angiography system, a second 1.5 tesla MRI, a high-performance CT scanner and a surgical robot. The ULS says the imaging systems include AI where applicable, helping to optimise radiation dose on the CT and the angiograph.
ai_news.ai_path: A public hospital buys medical imaging machines with AI features: one step from AI, because the AI is a built-in feature of the equipment and the article gives no detail on it.

ai_news.title: Politécnico de Viseu shows RISKMAP, an AI tool that watches over heritage buildings
ai_news.summary: The polytechnic leads a project with the universities of Aveiro and Porto's engineering faculty to build a virtual model of a heritage building that uses photographs, thermal images and sensors to flag degradation risks. The Grão Vasco National Museum in Viseu is one of two case studies, and the building manager decides how far the AI acts.
ai_news.ai_path: A Viseu research project building an AI tool for heritage risk: directly about AI. The RTP page gives no publication date, only that the presentation was on a Friday, so we show the year.

ai_news.title: STAR Institute opens in Viseu with AI among its core areas and two startups on site
ai_news.summary: The technology and innovation centre on the polytechnic's campus was inaugurated on 22 May 2026 with the prime minister present. It reports 40 people, 15 R&D projects, more than 20 companies served, a spin-off and two startups, and the Observador report says one startup is tied to AI and the other to cybersecurity. Its own site lists AI first under digitalisation and offers a humanoid and a quadruped robot with AI.
ai_news.ai_path: A Viseu research and technology centre that names AI as a focus area and hosts an AI-linked startup: directly about AI. The building cost 3.5 million euros from the recovery plan, according to Observador.

ai_news.title: Viseu's polytechnic runs a second edition of its generative AI course for higher education teachers
ai_news.summary: The institution's news page lists the second edition of the microcredential Education and AI, announced on 15 May 2026. The course brochure describes 27 hours on using generative AI critically and ethically in teaching, with in-person sessions in Viseu.
ai_news.ai_path: A Viseu university course on generative AI: directly about AI. We read the news listing and the course brochure, not the announcement page itself.

ai_news.title: The CIM gathers 240 teachers in Viseu to debate AI in schools
ai_news.summary: On 14 March 2026 the intermunicipal body held a colloquium at the polytechnic's technology and management school on AI in teaching, with panels on classroom use and ethical limits. The council's vice-president opened it.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional public body convenes teachers on AI in education: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Viseu Digital Tech spends an afternoon on AI for companies
ai_news.summary: The second edition took place on 12 February 2026 at the polytechnic's technology and management school, organised by CESAE Digital, with talks on the strategic impact of AI on business, AI in marketing and consulting, and practical automation cases.
ai_news.ai_path: A business event in Viseu about AI and process automation: directly about AI. Source is the organiser's own page.

ai_news.title: Viseu hosts MAESTRO-AI, an Erasmus+ project on teaching maths and programming in the AI era
ai_news.summary: From 9 to 13 February 2026 the polytechnic received partners from Poland, Greece and Romania for the Erasmus+ project MAESTRO-AI, which develops AI tools to support learning and ethical principles for AI in education. Students and teachers tested teaching proposals at the technology and management school.
ai_news.ai_path: A European education project run partly in Viseu that builds AI tools for learning: directly about AI. The date is the article's, the meeting was the following week.

ai_news.title: The polytechnic issues its rules for AI tools
ai_news.summary: Despacho 91/2025, signed on 10 December 2025, sets out guidelines on AI use for the academic community, citing the EU AI Act, and aims at pedagogical, creative and safe use while protecting academic integrity and personal data.
ai_news.ai_path: The Viseu institution sets its own rules for AI use: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: The council helps launch AI4PA training for public servants with a first session in Viseu
ai_news.summary: The municipality's own news page announced that the first of five training events of the AI4PA Portugal hub would be held at the Museu do Quartzo in Viseu on 26 February 2025, on generative AI and AI-driven public services, with the then mayor opening it. The event page lists the council as co-organiser.
ai_news.ai_path: The council co-hosts AI training for public administration: directly about AI. Read on the council's own site, which now loads.

ai_map.name: Universidade Politécnica de Viseu (until 31 July 2026 Instituto Politécnico de Viseu, IPV)
ai_map.what: Viseu's public higher education institution. Its own news page says it became a university on 1 August 2026 under the new higher education law, keeping its courses, staff and Viseu base. It issued AI use guidelines in December 2025, runs a generative AI course for teachers, hosts the CISeD digital services research centre and leads the RiskMap AI project.
ai_map.ai_path: Sets AI policy, teaches generative AI and leads an AI research project.

ai_map.name: RiskMap (IPV with Universidade de Aveiro and FEUP)
ai_map.what: A project from 1 October 2025 to 29 September 2028 with 244,944 euros of eligible investment, building an AI tool that maps degradation risk in historic building facades using machine learning, computer vision and BIM. Case studies include the Grão Vasco National Museum in Viseu.
ai_map.ai_path: An AI product in development at the Viseu institution.

ai_map.name: Município de Viseu (Câmara Municipal)
ai_map.what: Member of the 19-organisation AI4PA Portugal hub and co-organiser of its first training session in Viseu in February 2025. It also co-organised IndustriaTech+AI 2026. We found no AI use in the council's own services on its news and business pages.
ai_map.ai_path: Takes part in a national AI hub for the public sector and co-hosts AI industry events.

ai_map.name: AI4PA Portugal (European Digital Innovation Hub)
ai_map.what: A hub supporting the digital transformation of public administration and SMEs with AI and data science, with 19 members across Portugal. Its first training session of a five-stop cycle was held in Viseu on 26 February 2025 at the Museu do Quartzo.
ai_map.ai_path: A national AI adoption hub with Viseu as one of its training stops and members.

ai_map.name: CIM Viseu Dão Lafões (Comunidade Intermunicipal)
ai_map.what: The intermunicipal body of the Viseu Dão Lafões region. Presented its SMART REGION data platforms at the first Smart Region Summit on 29 October 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Builds data platforms whose stated aim is to use AI for regional decisions.

ai_map.name: AIRV (Associação Empresarial da Região de Viseu) and its business incubator
ai_map.what: The Viseu region's business association, which runs an incubator in the Expobeiras building with 34 offices, open to any sector and linked to the polytechnic. Co-organiser of IndustriaTech+AI 2026. The incubator page does not mention AI.
ai_map.ai_path: Co-hosts an industry event with AI as a central theme. The incubator itself shows no AI focus on the page we read.

ai_map.name: CESAE Digital
ai_map.what: Training centre for digital skills with a Viseu site. The search snippet of its Viseu page lists a free AI marketing course in Viseu in June 2026, and it organised Viseu Digital Tech 2026 at the polytechnic. Its own course pages show an AI and data science offer, but they sit on its national site.
ai_map.ai_path: Runs a Viseu event on AI for companies.

ai_map.name: STAR Institute (Centro de Tecnologia e Inovação)
ai_map.what: First recognised technology and innovation centre of the Viseu district, on the polytechnic campus, focused on the automotive sector and its neighbours. Its site lists AI under digitalisation, offers computer vision and a humanoid and a quadruped robot with AI, and its associates include Stellantis, Simoldes and Roboplan. It reports a spin-off and two startups on site.
ai_map.ai_path: A research centre with AI as the first of its digitalisation areas.

ai_map.name: ViTeB (Visabeira I&D Test Bed)
ai_map.what: A test bed run by Visabeira Investigação e Desenvolvimento at the Palácio do Gelo in Viseu, in the national test bed network, helping SMEs and startups test products. Its listed skills start with artificial intelligence and collaborative robotics, and its projects page shows an internal project called Visa AI.
ai_map.ai_path: A Viseu test bed that names AI as its first competence.

ai_map.name: CISeD (Centro de Investigação em Serviços Digitais, UPV)
ai_map.what: The polytechnic's research centre in digital services. Its page names partners such as Bizdirect and Softinsa and a line on digital decision support systems. The page we read does not mention AI, so this is a link, not a finding of AI work.
ai_map.ai_path: A digital research centre at the Viseu university whose AI work we did not confirm on the page opened.

ai_map.name: ULS Viseu Dão-Lafões (hospital group)
ai_map.what: The district's public health unit. It says its new CT, MRI and angiography systems bought with recovery plan money include AI where applicable.
ai_map.ai_path: Buys imaging equipment with built-in AI features.

ai_map.name: Roboplan
ai_map.what: Robotics firm listed as an associate of the STAR Institute. The page does not give its base or any AI product.
ai_map.ai_path: Robotics company linked to a Viseu centre that works on AI: its own AI work is not shown.

ai_map.name: Flowbotic
ai_map.what: Portuguese firm making autonomous mobile robots and intralogistics vehicles, described on the STAR Institute associates page as working on AI for Industry 4.0. The page gives no city, so its base in Viseu is not confirmed.
ai_map.ai_path: Robotics firm tied to a Viseu centre and described as working on AI for industry: one step from AI. Base not stated.

extras.label: Viseu Investe record
extras.value: The council's Viseu Investe programme (2014) says it attracted 22 investments worth 132 million euros and over 1,400 jobs, naming CUF, IBM, Bizdirect, Pampilar and Goucam. The page does not say any of them is AI work.

gaps: No AI company or startup headquartered in Viseu that we could name. The STAR Institute says one startup on its premises is tied to AI and one to cybersecurity, but none of its pages we opened names them. The AIRV incubated-firms page loaded with no readable names. The STAR associates page and the AIRV member list are the sources to read next. Third pass (17 Nov): the STAR associates page lists 23 associates, none labelled a cybersecurity startup; Flowbotic (AI for Industry 4.0, autonomous robots) is the only clear AI entry, with no city given, so it is on the map with its base unconfirmed. The two on-site startups remain unnamed.

Council news now loads and carries no AI item since the February 2025 AI4PA event. Its RSS address answers with an empty template, so there is no working council feed. The council's AI4PA project sheet was not read. Third pass (17 Nov): the council news and Gabinete do Investidor pages now answer 403 to our fetch, so they could not be re-read; the council RSS is still not working.
RiskMap's RTP page shows no publication date, only that the presentation was on a Friday, so the news item carries the year only.

Critical Software (320,000 euros and about 200 future jobs, 27 November 2025), UAVision (up to 5 million euros for a high-altitude unmanned aircraft system, 15 September 2026) and Empowered Startups (an agreement with the polytechnic, September 2025) all invest or partner in Viseu, but the pages we read do not mention AI, so they are left off the map.
ViTeB's PRR sheet ends on 15 June 2026 and its site shows no news since 2023, so whether the test bed still takes projects is not confirmed. Its Visa AI project page was not opened.
CISeD's page shows partners and research lines but no AI project. A search summary mentions machine learning projects, which we did not read on a page of its own.
No upcoming Viseu AI event found after 29 October 2026. Organisers to watch: CESAE Digital, the polytechnic, STAR Institute, AIRV and CIM Viseu Dão Lafões.
Investors: only public programme money is sourced (RiskMap's EU regional funding, the PRR for STAR and ViTeB, the Viseu Investe scheme). No private funding round for a Viseu AI company found.

Start a company: we did not open pages for Startup Portugal's national programmes, the Empresa na Hora counter or the CIM's incubator network and social innovation incubator (found in a search, not opened), so those routes are not listed. The council's V21 technology incubation centre appeared only in a 2020 article, so its status is unknown.
IBM, Bizdirect and Softinsa appear as investors or partners in Viseu on the council and CISeD pages, but no page we opened ties them to AI work in Viseu, so they are not on the map.

Not yet looked for: the Observatório Beira's AI debate (named in an opinion column, no page opened), the AI4PA hub's later sessions, and the district's other municipalities. The STAR Institute's own project list loads as headings only.
Talent: no people listed. We listed institutions only and did not find a public profile of a Viseu AI practitioner who has agreed to be named.

Third pass (17 Nov): the polytechnic, Diário de Viseu, Mais Beiras and STAR feeds all answer. No item about AI in Viseu was published since 16 Nov (latest items: UPV technology transfer office visit to Gumervias, STAR event of 26 Oct), so no AI news was added.

Fourth pass (20 Nov, window 17 to 20 Nov): the UPV, Diário de Viseu, Mais Beiras, STAR and Viseu Now feeds answer (Terras de Viseu answers with an almost empty feed). Items in the window checked for AI: none found. Opened UPV Jornadas Inclusivas (Viseu Now, 19 Nov), UPV Healthy Workplaces conference (Mais Beiras, 19 Nov) and the Viseu security council report (Viseu Now, 18 Nov): none mentions AI. The UPV feed has nothing after 16 Nov and STAR nothing after 26 Oct. No AI news was added.

voice.lede: Viseu, oh pá: granite all the way down, a cathedral looking down on the Dão, and somehow the quietest AI scene in the Beira, busy writing rules and building tools to watch over old museums instead of shouting about it.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Viseu, a cidade do Grão Vasco: AI and tech in Viseu, with the polytechnic as the big brain on the hill, the council and the CIM making data talk, plus whatever news arrives from Portugal and the world. Independente, and every fact comes with a receipt.
voice.gravity: Viseu does its AI the way it drinks its Dão: slowly, seriously and with a good paper trail. The polytechnic writes the rules and builds RiskMap to guard a museum, the council joins a national hub, the CIM puts mayors in front of a data platform, and industry throws conferences. Startups? Procuram-se, we could not find a single one with a Viseu address.
voice.gaps_intro: Ainda não sabemos tudo, pá. Here is what Viseu has not told us yet:

start_company.name: AIRV business incubator (Expobeiras building, Coimbrões)
start_company.what: Virtual and physical incubation with 34 equipped offices, regional IAPMEI and AICEP offices on site, an acceleration programme and a link to the polytechnic. Open to any sector and maturity, with priority for projects tied to the Viseu region.

start_company.name: Câmara Municipal de Viseu: Gabinete do Investidor (Viseu Investe)
start_company.what: The council's investor office offers a single qualified contact point, a simplified process and ongoing follow-up for productive investment projects in all sectors. A funding scheme for municipal economic initiatives (regulation and application form) sits under Viseu Investe.

start_company.name: Área de Acolhimento Empresarial de Lordosa
start_company.what: Council business park whose lots are to be sold by public auction soon. The page publishes the regulation and the first-phase plan and says more information will follow.

start_company.name: STAR Institute: technology services and startup space
start_company.what: The centre says it serves companies with product and process development, automation, robotics and AI services, and that a spin-off and two startups are installed in its building. Its pages give no application route for new startups.

start_company.name: ViTeB test bed (Visabeira I&D)
start_company.what: A pre-industrial test bed for SMEs and startups to develop and test products, with AI among its thematic areas. Its contact page offers a web form.

start_company.name: UPV Gabinete de Transferência de Tecnologia and INOVC+
start_company.what: The university's technology transfer office runs the INOVC+ ignition and proof-of-concept contest. Its third edition funded four projects on 21 July 2026 (UVC drying, 3D printing, wool insulation, foundry sand). None is about AI.

start_company.name: AIRV: association and business parks
start_company.what: The business association says it has over 500 member firms, 25 or more incubated firms, legal services, training and rented space. It was founded in 1982.

investors.name: COMPETE 2030 (FEDER) into RiskMap
investors.what: The project sheet lists a total incentive of 208,202.40 euros on 244,944 euros of eligible investment, of which 73,072.80 euros is the polytechnic's share.
investors.ai_path: Funds an AI tool for heritage building risk: directly about AI.

investors.name: PRR (Recovery and Resilience Plan) into the STAR Institute building
investors.what: Observador reports 3.5 million euros from the PRR for the building of the STAR Institute, which also reports a consortium of 36 entities. The 5 million euro total in some press is not on the pages we opened.
investors.ai_path: Paid for the building of a centre with AI as a focus area: one step from AI.

investors.name: PRR into ViTeB (Visabeira I&D TestBed)
investors.what: Transparency portal sheet: 5.58 million euros total, all non-repayable, 3.94 million paid at the time of reading, running from 1 September 2022 to 15 June 2026, under digital transition of companies.
investors.ai_path: Funds a test bed whose first listed competence is AI: one step from AI.

investors.name: PRR into the ULS Viseu Dão-Lafões imaging equipment
investors.what: 5.8 million euros contracted for heavy medical equipment and a surgical robot, with AI tools in the imaging systems where applicable.
investors.ai_path: Pays for scanners with built-in AI features: one step from AI.

investors.name: Viseu Investe (municipal programme)
investors.what: Council programme since 2014 to attract investment, with a regulation and application form for economic initiatives of municipal interest. The page claims 22 investments worth 132 million euros.
investors.ai_path: General investment support with no AI focus on the page: two steps from AI, only through firms that might use it.

contacts.what: The council's published channel for investors, with an enquiry form and a published office email and phone.
contacts.channel: the investor office's email and phone, published on the council's Contactos page and on its Gabinete do Investidor page (open the linked page for the address)

contacts.what: The council's published general email and phone.
